items.title: Stray Kids Join BTS in Sitting Out Grammy Awards
items.summary: Popular K-pop group Stray Kids let the submission window for the 69th Grammy Awards close without entering any music, their agency JYP Entertainment confirmed on Friday, joining BTS in sitting out the ceremony.

items.title: ‘The Great British Bake Off’ Host Alison Hammond Has Heart Check After Health Scare Live On TV
items.summary: Alison Hammond has revealed that she went to hospital to have tests done on her heart after suffering a health scare midway through presenting This Morning on ITV.

items.title: ‘The Watcher’ Season 2 to Begin Production 4 Years After Season 1 With Bobby Cannavale, Naomi Watts Returning
